title: News: overview film
description: Articles and releases in your theme. A narrated tour, recorded in this TYPO3 v14 lab, with English captions.
alt: Overview film, 57 seconds: News for TYPO3 v14. Cards with page numbers; Date, teaser and content; A familiar form for editors; The same list in dark mode. Narrated, with English captions.

transcript.text: The News extension is the standard for articles in TYPO3, but every project restyles its list and its articles.
Desiderio’s templates give News your theme, from the list to the article.
The list shows each article as a card, with its date, a teaser and page numbers below.
Articles open with the date, the title and the teaser, followed by content elements.
Editors write in a record form, with tabs for media, categories and related articles.
Switch to dark mode, and cards, badges and page numbers follow.
News by Georg Ringer, styled by Desiderio.
